hero.title: Healthcare Information Should Lead to Action, Not More Searching
hero.subtitle: RaiderCare was created around a simple problem: when students feel unwell, finding the right next step can be harder than it should be. Health information is everywhere, but knowing what to do with that information is not always clear. RaiderCare is our attempt to make that journey simpler, safer, and more understandable.

sectionHeader.title: What We Believe
sectionHeader.subtitle: RaiderCare is built around principles that keep the experience useful, responsible, and focused on helping students make informed decisions.

items.title: Clarity Over Information Overload
items.text: Finding health information is easy. Understanding what matters and what to do next is harder. RaiderCare focuses on turning complicated health information into clear and understandable next steps.

items.title: Safety Before Certainty
items.text: RaiderCare is not designed to make definitive medical diagnoses. When symptoms may indicate a serious situation, the priority is recognizing the warning signs and directing the user toward appropriate professional or emergency care.

items.title: Human Care Stays at the Center
items.text: Technology can help people navigate healthcare, but it should never replace qualified medical professionals. RaiderCare is designed to help users reach the right people, not replace them.

items.title: Built Around Student Needs
items.text: Students often need answers quickly and may not know which type of care is appropriate. RaiderCare is designed to make that first decision easier through a simple and approachable experience.

items.title: Privacy by Design
items.text: Health-related concerns can be personal. RaiderCare is being built with secure authentication, protected user access, and thoughtful handling of user information as core parts of the experience.

items.title: Technology That Connects
items.text: The goal isn't to keep users inside an app. The goal is to help them confidently move from a concern to an appropriate real-world healthcare resource when professional support is needed.

sectionHeader.title: Why We Built RaiderCare
sectionHeader.subtitle: The idea started with a familiar problem: health information is easy to find, but the right next step often isn't.

items.title: We Saw the Problem
items.text: When students experience unfamiliar symptoms, their first reaction is often to search online. That can quickly turn into dozens of articles, conflicting explanations, and uncertainty about whether the situation is minor, urgent, or somewhere in between.

items.title: We Asked a Different Question
items.text: Instead of building another place that simply provides more health information, we asked: what if technology could help students understand what action to take next?

items.title: RaiderCare Took Shape
items.text: That idea became RaiderCare: a health-navigation experience designed to listen to a user's concern, consider important warning signs, provide basic guidance, and point them toward an appropriate type of care.

items.title: Beyond the Feed
items.text: RaiderCare reflects our belief that useful technology should move people beyond endless searching and scrolling. The experience is designed around reaching a decision and taking the next appropriate step.

cta.title: From Uncertainty to a Clearer Next Step
cta.text: RaiderCare is designed to help students spend less time searching for answers and more time understanding where to turn for appropriate care.
